children: realtrumpcoins said claims about Trump Coins issuing, promoting, or authorizing a digital token are false and attributed the information to third-party malicious activity. The account said Trump Coins has never authorized any digital token and will not issue, promote, or authorize any digital token in the future.

According to PANews, realtrumpcoins said it is working with relevant law enforcement agencies to investigate the matter and seek accountability for those responsible. The report also said the realtrumpcoins account, which has drawn attention from U.S. President Donald Trump, previously launched the $GOLD token, with the team holding 82.45% of the supply.

title: realtrumpcoins Denies Trump Coins Token Issuance and Promotion Claims
